name: briefing_set_progress_and_sleep
description: Briefing::SetProgressAndSleep forwards progress to the runtime transport-progress SetNormalizedValueAndRebuild method when a briefing runtime exists, then sleeps for 100 ms; with no runtime it only sleeps.
